name: [ 🚀🪐Planet ] +1 Slap Tool Size Every Second
desc:
+1 Slap Tool Size Every Second

Every second, your Slap Tool grows—and your power goes crazy!
Push walls, earn trophies, and unlock even stronger tools as you grow nonstop!

🔥 Game Features:

🪜 Auto Size Growth
Your Slap Tool increases in size every second—no clicking needed.

💥 Knockback Scales with Size
The bigger your Slap Tool gets, the stronger your knockback power becomes.

🧱 Wall Push Challenge
Different walls have different strength levels. Push them as far as required to progress.

🏆 Trophy Rewards
Push a wall far enough and earn trophies to unlock stronger Slap Tools and new stages.

🔁 Rebirth System
Rebirth to reset your size but gain:
Faster growth per second

💪 Can you build the biggest Slap Tool and crush every wall?

Grow nonstop, dominate challenges, and become the ultimate Slap Titan!
